svg.aria-label: Two broker topologies. Hierarchical: a top-level broker connects in both directions to region A, region B and region C brokers, and each regional broker exchanges traffic with two clients and one server. Federated: brokers A, B, C and D are peers, each linked to every other broker in both directions through a bridge, and each broker serves two clients and one server
svg.text: A hierarchy routes through a top-level broker; federated brokers connect to each other as peers.
